_readme: Every shipped script is classified here. proofs: a test that has been watched redden the check, named <test path>::<function> (the function must actually run under bare python - run_tests.py does not use pytest). gaps: it should have a red proof and does not, with why - this is a burn-down list, keep it shrinking. exempt: it is not a reject check at all, with why. An unclassified script fails evals/harness/test_red_proofs.py, which is the point: a new check cannot ship without someone deciding which bucket it is in.

gaps.evals/harness/offer_probe.py: Returns 0/1 over its probe results and has no paired test at all, so nothing has ever watched it fail. It gates a paid run, which is exactly where a hollow green is dearest. Burn down by feeding it a probe result set that must fail and asserting the exit code.
gaps.evals/harness/smoke.py: Same shape as offer_probe: `0 if all(results) else 1` with no paired test. It is the go/no-go before spending a matrix, so a green it cannot fail is the most expensive kind here.
gaps.evals/harness/token_probe.py: A measurement helper with no paired test. Classify properly on next contact - if it has no reject path it belongs in `exempt`, and if it does it needs a proof.

exempt.evals/harness/aggregate.py: Eval driver, not a reject check; its scoring core is covered by test_aggregate.py and it is mirrored into the evaluate-skill plugin under the byte-identity gate test_scripts_in_sync.py.
exempt.evals/harness/claude_runner.py: Spawn plumbing for the eval harness. It has no verdict of its own to redden; failures surface as errored trials that run_triggers scores.
exempt.evals/harness/grade_tasks.py: Eval driver that produces grades rather than a pass/fail verdict; covered by test_grade_tasks.py and mirrored under test_scripts_in_sync.py.
exempt.evals/harness/judge.py: Eval driver: it renders a judgement prompt and parses the reply. The verdict belongs to the model, not to this module, so there is no reject path to prove.
exempt.evals/harness/run_all.py: Orchestrator over the other eval drivers; its argument guards are covered by test_build_command.py and it is mirrored under test_scripts_in_sync.py.
exempt.evals/harness/run_triggers.py: Scoring and spawn driver. Its pure core (score_skill, validate_queries) is covered by several harness tests; the module itself reports rates rather than rejecting, and gate thresholds are applied by callers.
exempt.evals/harness/stats.py: Pure statistics library with no CLI and no verdict. Its one refusal (no normal method below n=30) is proved at the validator level in experiment-rigor's test_validate.py.
exempt.plugins/engineering-discipline/hooks/har: A seam that forwards payloads to the two hook cores; the rejection it carries belongs to uv_enforce, which has its own proof.
exempt.plugins/engineering-discipline/hooks/ruf: Formatter hook, deliberately incapable of rejecting: every path returns 0 so a format failure can never block a session. test_ruff_format.py pins that property, including that the destructive autofix is never added.
exempt.plugins/experiment-discipline/skills/exp: A reader that summarises a fathom ledger into record fields. Single `return 0`; the validation of what it produces is validate.py's job.
Pure statistics library, no CLI, no verdict - same reading as the harness copy above.
exempt.plugins/humblepowers/skills/choosing-too: UserPromptSubmit hook that must fail open: a non-zero exit or a hang would block the user's prompt. test_inject_dispatch.py pins that every path exits 0, including on malformed stdin.
Its CLI is a debug view that always returns 0; the router's real gate is the calibration floors in test_router.py, which carry their own reddening self-test for the backtracking detector.
exempt.plugins/session-workflow/skills/compacti: SessionStart hook, fail-open by contract: every path including the outer except exits 0, because a hook that blocks session start is worse than a missing anchor.
exempt.plugins/session-workflow/skills/evaluate: Mirrored copy of the harness driver; byte-identity is enforced by test_scripts_in_sync.py and the behaviour is tested on the harness side.

exempt.plugins/session-workflow/skills/tool-fee: Stop hook that must fail open; test_feedback_nudge.py pins that an unknown mode and garbage stdin both exit 0, because a nudge that blocks Stop is worse than a missed nudge.
exempt.plugins/session-workflow/skills/toolkit-: Diagnostic reporter: it prints caveats and always exits 0 by design, so the operator sees skew without the scan itself becoming a gate. Its findings-level negatives are covered in test_scan_toolkit.py.
